  • Details: Fine woven embossing, flared trapezoidal silhouette, wide-opening top

Dimension:

  • Dimensions: 6” H x 12” W x 4” D
  • Capacity: It accommodates all your daily essentials, including a large smartphone, a full-sized wallet, a sunglasses case, and a key ring. Its generous 4-inch depth provides ample room for a small makeup pouch, hand sanitizer, and a slim power bank without losing its sleek silhouette.
  • Strap Length & Type: 13” and Non-Adjustable. Long Strap: 45” and Adjustable

  • Cleaning & Maintenance Guidelines
    • Use a microfiber cloth to remove dust and dirt. For light stains, wipe with a damp cloth and allow to air dry.
    • Keep Out of direct sunlight. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use.
    • Keep your bag in a dust bag or soft cloth pouch to protect it from dust and scratches.
    • Keep your bag away from rough surfaces or sharp items that could cause damage.

Always test a small area before proceeding to clean the entire article
